title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go, parity fixes, v1.96.1 bumps
author: Ethan Liu
description:
Motivation: We maintain three SDK stacks (Python, TypeScript, Go) and have drift in auth retry semantics, streaming ergonomics, and small parity differences in method names/option shapes. This PR unifies behavior across SDKs so application code can be ported between runtimes with minimal changes and reduces support surface for server teams.

What this PR does (single-line description): Unify auth token refresh + retry policy, standardize streaming APIs (resume/cancel callbacks, backpressure hooks), fix parity bugs, and bump SDK package versions to v1.96.1.

Changes summary (checklist):
- [x] Add unified AuthProvider interface and token-refresh + retry helper used by all SDKs
- [x] Normalize streaming client APIs: on_data/on_error/on_close plus optional backpressure.resume() hook
- [x] Fix parity: consistent param names (timeout -> request_timeout), embed model/route metadata uniformly
- [x] Update docs and examples across sdks and examples repo
- [x] Bump package versions: python 1.96.1, typescript 1.96.1, go 1.96.1
- [x] Add unit + integration tests covering token expiry and streaming reconnection behavior

Why this approach: Centralizing the small but critical auth/retry logic reduces duplicated edge-case code and ensures consistent behavior under intermittent network errors and 401 refresh flows. Standardizing streaming ergonomics improves developer DX (single event model) and makes it easier to implement higher-level helpers in the console and examples.

Testing: Added cross-SDK integration test harness that simulates token expiry mid-stream and flaky connections. Local CI run + staging pipeline exercised Python and TS example apps against the new client.

Backward compatibility notes: The unified AuthProvider implements the previous interfaces (thin adapters included). Streaming API exposes a deprecation shim for old callback names for one release with logging. Consumers who used custom retry strategies should switch to the new RetryConfig; adapters are provided.

Related Linear items: ENG-7842 (unify sdks auth/retry), ENG-7899 (streaming ergonomics), PM-321 (sdk parity checklist).

Merge notes: Small, focused commits; squash-merged to main after approvals and CI green.

fix(py): ensure token refresh race prevents duplicate refresh requests

release_notes: Unified auth/retry behavior across SDKs; improved streaming ergonomics; fixed parity bugs; bumped SDK versions to v1.96.1.
